blocks.text: Cedrick Juan challenged politicians to change the public’s negative perception of them by doing their jobs honestly, noting that their unflattering portrayal in films reflects how society sees them. During the recent advance screening and talkback of his upcoming psychological thriller film “Andoy,” Juan was asked about the political message of the story, which touches on issues of political corruption and nepotism. The actor acknowledged the country’s current political situation, saying there is no need to cover up the wrongdoings of those in power. “Alam naman natin ‘yung nangyari sa Pilipinas ngayon.
